p1_high.title: Missing Environment Variables Template
reproduction_steps: 3. Observe: Firebase init fails with missing config vars
4. Expected: Clear template showing required environment variables
p1_high.impact: Cannot run dev server locally or configure Firebase client SDK
p1_high.suggested_fix: Create web/.env.local.example with all required Firebase config keys from firebase-admin-key.json and hosting setup
acceptance_criteria: File web/.env.local.example exists with all NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* vars
README.md updated with setup instructions referencing the template
Developers can copy template and fill values to run dev server

p1_high.title: Missing Logo Asset (SVG)
p1_high.impact: Text-only branding in navbar; visual mismatch with reference image
p1_high.suggested_fix: UI team extracts logo from reference image, provides optimized SVG with multiple size variants. FE updates navbar imports.
acceptance_criteria: web/public/assets/logo.svg exists with optimized markup
Logo variants provided: logo-icon.svg (icon only), logo-full.svg (with text)
Navbar updated to use <Image> or <svg> component
Logo displays correctly on light/dark backgrounds
Visual match confirmed against /mnt/data/webapp.JPG

p1_high.title: No Automated Test Infrastructure
reproduction_steps: 3. Check for test files in __tests__/ or *.test.ts
4. Expected: Test runner (Vitest/Jest) configured with smoke tests
p1_high.impact: No regression safety net; cannot verify fixes before merge
p1_high.suggested_fix: Add Vitest to workspace packages with smoke tests for: API endpoints, Firebase Auth, Firestore queries, UI component mounting
acceptance_criteria: Vitest configured in root package.json and workspace packages
Smoke tests cover: /api/health, /api/v1/voice-otp validation, homepage rendering
CI integration: tests run on PR
Coverage report generated (minimum 60% for critical paths)
Test documentation in ci/testing-guide.md
test_scenarios: API: POST /api/v1/voice-otp with valid payload returns 200
UI: Homepage renders without console errors

p2_medium.title: Missing OpenAPI Documentation
p2_medium.impact: External integrations require manual code inspection; no Postman import
p2_medium.suggested_fix: Generate OpenAPI spec from existing Zod schemas in functions/src/api/. Use @asteasolutions/zod-to-openapi or similar.
acceptance_criteria: docs/openapi.yaml generated with all /api/v1/* endpoints
Spec includes request/response schemas from Zod validators
Authentication schemes documented (x-api-key, x-webhook-secret)
Postman collection generated from spec
Spec validates with Swagger Editor

p2_medium.title: No Visual Regression Tests
reproduction_steps: 1. Check CI pipeline for screenshot comparison
3. Manual verification required for UI changes
4. Expected: Automated screenshot diff on PR
p2_medium.impact: Cannot detect unintended style changes; CSS regressions slip through
p2_medium.suggested_fix: Add Playwright with screenshot testing. Baseline images from current production. Percy/Chromatic optional for hosted solution.
acceptance_criteria: Playwright configured with @playwright/test
Screenshot tests for: homepage, dashboard, login, logs pages
Baseline images committed to repo
CI fails on pixel diff > 0.1%
Update workflow documented for intentional UI changes

p2_medium.title: Dashboard Performance: Excessive Firestore Reads
reproduction_steps: 3. Observe: Real-time listeners cause continuous reads
4. Expected: Pagination + caching to reduce read volume
p2_medium.impact: High Firestore costs with scale; real-time updates may not be required for all data
p2_medium.suggested_fix: Add pagination for logs table. Use SWR or React Query for caching static data (API keys, usage summary). Keep real-time only for critical live data.
acceptance_criteria: Logs page implements pagination (20 items per page)
SWR caching added for /api/v1/usage/summary (60s stale time)
API keys fetched once on settings page load (not real-time)
Firestore read count reduced by >70% on typical dashboard session
Performance metrics documented in ci/performance-report.md
